base_version.description: The version from your last read (an insight's updated_at, a flag's version, or the version a previous call returned). If the object has changed since, nothing is written and you get a conflict.

dry_run.description: Apply and validate the change and show the diff, without writing.

patch.description: Merge patch (RFC 7396) on that one question, e.g. {"question":"New text"} or {"choices":["A","B"]}. null removes a key. The question id cannot change.

question_id.description: The question's id from a survey read. Preferred over question_index.
